queries: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall FROM Laboratory), a AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb FROM p, o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - o.overall AS above_overall, a.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM a) AS above_group_avg FROM a, o ORDER BY above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall FROM p), a AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb FROM p, o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - o.overall AS above_overall, a.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM a) AS above_group_avg FROM a, o ORDER BY above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS m FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), ab AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a, p.a - o.m AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.a > o.m) SELECT ID, a AS avg_hgb, diff AS above_overall_avg, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM ab) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM ab ORDER BY diff_from_above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall average hemoglobin' is the average of HGB over all lab records (row-weighted), not the average of per-patient averages.
Patients with no non-null HGB values are excluded; 'average of these above-average patients' averages' is the unweighted mean of their per-patient averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Overall average is the mean of the per-patient average HGB values (each patient weighted equally) rather than the mean over all lab records.
